title: Local surjectivity of constant matrix lattice classes
statement: For the finite p-adic coefficient extension, an exact lattice class presentation and a rational frame [lem-weil-pbc-lattice-pair-image-classification], the constant-coset presheaf map [lem-weil-pbc-lattice-coset-map] is locally surjective: every class is locally represented by a constant invertible matrix.

proof.text: On a frame chart W, evaluate G at each point x. Continuity of matrix entries and inverse entries gives an open neighborhood with constant right coset. Use the continuous integral lifting lemma to identify the sectionwise matrix lattice with that constant-matrix lattice on every further object.

proof.text: The open neighborhoods cover W. Apply the existing ProEt.mem_topology_of_openImmersion directly to obtain a pro-etale covering, with no etale comparison detour. The restriction criterion for the coset map makes these arrows members of its image sieve. Transitivity with the original frame cover proves local surjectivity.
